definition: The inner surface of a building, wall or surface.
The external (outer) surface of a building, wall, floor or ceiling.
The centre plane of a wall or floor slab.
The lower (under) surface of a building, floor, floor slab or ceiling.
The upper surface of a building, floor or ceiling.
The surface of a building, wall, floor or ceiling.
The plane of a building, wall, floor or ceiling.
The projected continuation of a building, wall, floor, ceiling or associated surface or plane used to define a boundary beyond the physical extent of the referenced feature.
A parcel solid face determined by the vertical plane of a 2D title boundary.
The boundary is offset by a stated distance from a referenced surface or plane; the direction of the offset is given by vertical-direction.
